notes: The 0.9.177 update did not install for anyone running GOAT from the tray, and this release fixes that. Pressing Update in a GOAT window closed that window's own server and nothing else: the tray and its server stayed up holding GOAT's files, the silent installer could not replace them and quietly rolled back, and GOAT came back on the old version offering the same update again. Every GOAT process now leaves together when an update starts, the installer is allowed to end anything still holding its files, and the tray comes back afterwards if it was there before. Also: opening GOAT while the tray already had its server running used to start a second server on the next port; the window now opens on the one that is already there. One-off for anyone on 0.9.176 or 0.9.177 with the tray running: right-click the tray icon, Quit GOAT, start GOAT again and press Update. Everything from 0.9.177 is included: the local server refuses requests from other websites, SMART says why when he could not answer, talking over the natural voice stops it at once, sign-out revokes the session on the server, and other drivers' names are shown as plain text.
